assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for paroxysmal arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I34.0 corresponds to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated to capture potential arrhythmic events
The CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study
The payer's denial under CO-197 asserts that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered
The clinical necessity documented is not satisfied by a procedural authorization requirement and remains medically appropriate
